_comment: Live extraction facts captured from Dynatrace tenant oat05854 (dynatrace-dev dtctl context) on 2026-10-10 by the workload-model skill, run UNCHANGED against the crewai-deepseek-agent app (ISI-5644 deploy+load, parent ISI-5630 generalization test). Every number came from a dtctl DQL query over the clean load window; queries are listed in metadata.source.queries of the emitted model. Terminal signal = execute_tool (AGENTIC_TOOL_PATTERNS) instead of order-terminal. This is the definitive DeepSeek + sustained-load generalization run that the openclaw-gateway probe (GLM, n~18) could not provide.
access_log_probe: fetch logs | filter k8s.container.name == 'istio-proxy' over the window -> 0 lines; mesh access logs not shipped on this tenant. HTTP surface (POST /request) recovered from the entry server-span route instead.

front_end.method: earliest-start root span per trace (G1-C) + noise classifier. crewai-deepseek-agent/request is the single clean entry for this service over the window; co-tenant astronomy-shop/honcho/memos/flagd entries dropped by service scope.
front_end.ingress_crosscheck: N/A - no istio-ingressgateway access logs on tenant; entry resolved from the span graph and reach-confirmed (301 root spans).

archetype_split.signal: trace contains an execute_tool span (AGENTIC_TOOL_PATTERNS) -> Agentic (tool-using turn); else Conversational (pure-LLM turn)

span_trees.agentic: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> execute_tool(web_search|calculator) -> Tool Usage -> llm.call -> chat -> (ReAct loop) -> finalize -> message.sent
span_trees.conversational: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> finalize -> message.sent

arrival.observed_concurrency_note: busy-time integral: sum(agent.turn duration) 686966696507 ns / window 1533e9 ns

full_window.note: two partial boundary buckets inflate sd; edge artifact of absolute-timestamp binning on a 25m33s window

interior.note: full interior minutes 08:36:00-09:01:00; true steady-state of the constant-arrival driver

driver.note: ProxOps in-cluster k6; one HTTP POST /request per turn, turn_type in {tool, chat}
